name: acf-advisor
description: Advisor + board-of-advisors skills - consult another LLM (with thinking/reasoning mode on) for a single second opinion, OR convene a multi-persona panel hypertailored to a specific decision. Board dispatches each persona as a parallel Claude Agent subagent (visible/cancellable in UI); synthesis is the orchestrator's own turn weighted by the user-chosen priority dimension. Personas synthesized per call from a structured recipe. Works against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; comma-delimited ADVISOR_MODEL declares a multi-model pool. Param shape routed per model family by name (no version pinning); ADVISOR_PROFILE override + shape-swap retry handle aliases and proxy translation gaps. Local-team fallback when no API endpoint is configured (each persona is a Claude subagent, no external calls).
